_apa_ini: What the candidate pools of the two channel tracks hold: candidates per row, whether both golds are in, whether the pool of a pair is identical, and the text-length limit.

track_berpasangan.cara_bangun: retrieval stage of the frozen system: BGE-M3 dense and sparse search each return the limit below, RRF merges them on the client side, and the result is cut to retrieval_pool_size; child chunks only, no program filter

track_luas.cara_bangun: mining script: the nearest neighbours of the gold chunk by dense cosine, then every gold of the group is forced in, so all golds are present by construction

definisi_resolved: a row is resolved when the asker's gold ranks above every gold of the other profiles in its group; a profile-blind scorer gives one ranking for the whole group, so exactly one row per group can win
label_source: deterministic (counts over the frozen pool files, the configuration, and the code)
